name: google-analytics-evals
description: Evaluation benchmarks for Google Analytics 4 ingestion, reporting, and SQL analytics.

evals.description: User requests downloading or syncing GA4 metrics to a local SQLite database
evals.prompt: Sync the latest Google Analytics 4 data to our local database

evals.description: User requests a high-level site overview report of GA4 metrics
evals.prompt: Show me our site overview and dwell time metrics from Google Analytics

evals.description: User requests top performing pages and article dwell times
evals.prompt: Which blog posts have the highest dwell time and readership?

evals.description: User requests country and localization breakdown
evals.prompt: Break down our website traffic by country and check how Japanese and Portuguese localizations are performing
expected_actions: Calls scripts/google_analytics.py report geo or runs localization SQL query

evals.description: User asks for specific SQL queries over GA4 data
evals.prompt: Run a SQL query to find all pages with over 100 views and their average bounce rate
expected_actions: Calls scripts/google_analytics.py query with valid SQL
